questions.question: Prepare a professional Curriculum Vitae (CV) using La Te X for a final-year undergraduate student applying for a research internship. Your CV should contain: (a) personal and contact information, (b) career objective/profile, (c) educational qualifications, (d) technical and scientific skills, (e) projects/research experience, (f) achievements, certifications and extracurricular activities, and (g) references/contact details where appropriate. Write the appropriate La Te X commands and structure required to create the CV. Explain how La Te X helps maintain consistent formatting and professional presentation.
